fullDescription: A trust-led dark CTA on deep navy with one warm amber accent: an avatar + 5-star social-proof row, an amber payoff headline, a glowing amber primary button beside a glass demo button, a no-card check-mark trust line, a 4-up hairline stat row, and a grayscale logo trust strip.
prompt:
## Resumo
A trust-led conversion CTA section on a deep navy canvas with a single warm amber accent. It opens with a compact context hero (eyebrow pill, two-line headline whose second line is amber, supporting subhead) over a faint grid and a soft amber radial glow, then flows into the anchor CTA block: an overlapping avatar cluster + 5 amber stars + 'loved by 1,200+ builders' social-proof row, an uppercase amber eyebrow, a big two-line headline (second line amber), a subhead, a dual button row (a glowing amber primary 'Start designing free' and a glass-outline 'Watch a 90s demo'), and a three-item check-mark trust line (no card / free forever / cancel anytime). Below sit a 4-up stat row with vertical hairline dividers (57k+ onboard, 2.4M mockups, <30s to first draft, 4.9 rating), a soft gradient divider, and a six-logo grayscale trust strip. Framed by a blurred sticky nav and a small social footer.

## Estilo Visual
Build a calm, premium dark SaaS look anchored on a trust-led CTA. Palette is navy + cream + ONE amber: navy-900 #081730 (page background), navy-850 #0b1f3a, navy-800 #0f2747, navy-700 #16315a (deeper panels / ring colors), cream #f6f1e7 (all text, used at full and reduced opacity 75/65/55/50/45/40), and amber #f0b429 (the single accent: headline payoff line, primary button, stars, eyebrow, check icons, the '+' in stats). Text colors are cream with opacity steps (text-cream, text-cream/70, /65, /55, /50, /45) so hierarchy comes from opacity, not new hues. Font is Inter (Google Fonts) loaded at 400-900; headlines use font-extrabold/900 with tight tracking and leading ~1.05; eyebrows are uppercase font-bold ~12px with letter-spacing 0.22em; body is regular/medium at reduced cream opacity. Use text-wrap: balance on headlines and lead paragraphs. Depth is SOFT, never hard-edged: (a) a faint grid overlay = two 1px cream lines at rgba(246,241,231,0.035) on a 56px 56px tile, radially mask-image'd radial-gradient(100% 80% at 50% 30%, #000 30%, transparent 78%) so it fades at the edges; (b) a hero glow = layered radial-gradients of amber at ~10% and navy-700 at ~55% blooming from the top corners; (c) a CTA glow = radial-gradient(120% 140% at 50% -6%, rgba(240,180,41,0.22), rgba(240,180,41,0.06) 28%, transparent 58%) over a vertical navy gradient #0d244a -> #0b1f3a -> #081730; (d) a 1px amber top-line = linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(240,180,41,0.55), transparent). Amber buttons get an inset top highlight + a large blurred amber drop shadow: box-shadow 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35) inset, 0 12px 30px -8px rgba(240,180,41,0.5), brightening on hover. Dividers and outlines are white-alpha hairlines (border-white/5, /10, /15; bg-white/[0.03]-[0.07]). The nav is glass: bg-navy-900/70 with backdrop-filter saturate(160%) blur(12px). Rounded corners are gentle (rounded-lg/xl/full). Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph) used sparingly in amber. Antialiased. Keep it restrained: one accent, soft glows, opacity-driven hierarchy, no second bright color.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Glass sticky nav
A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) with a thin bottom border (border-b border-white/5) and a glass fill (bg-navy-900/70 plus backdrop-filter saturate(160%) blur(12px)). Inside a mx-auto max-w-6xl h-16 row, px-6, justified between: LEFT = a 32px rounded-lg amber logo tile (bg-amber, text-navy-900, soft amber drop shadow) holding a ph:sparkle-fill icon, beside a 17px font-extrabold cream 'Promptcanvas' wordmark; CENTER (hidden on mobile, md:flex, gap-8) = four 14px font-medium cream/70 links 'Library / Canvas / Pricing / Docs' that brighten to full cream on hover; RIGHT = a 'Sign in' text link (cream/80, hidden on the smallest screens) and a rounded-lg amber 'Start free' button (bg-amber, text-navy-900, font-bold, brightens on hover).

### Compact context hero
A centered hero section with a .hero-glow background (layered amber + navy radial glows from the top corners) and an absolute faint grid overlay. In a max-w-6xl column, pt-20->24 pb-20, centered: an inline rounded-full pill (border-white/10, bg-white/[0.04], px-3.5 py-1.5, 12px cream/75) with an amber ph:lightning-fill icon and text 'New: one-shot component generation from a single prompt'; then a max-w-3xl text-balance h1 (text-4xl->5xl, font-extrabold, leading-[1.05], tight tracking) reading 'Describe the interface.' on line one and 'We design it on the canvas.' on line two in AMBER; then a max-w-xl mt-5 subhead (text-base->lg, leading-relaxed, cream/65): 'An AI design agent that turns plain-language prompts into production-ready UI, components, and full layouts on an infinite canvas.'

### CTA section shell
The anchor section (id='cta') with a .cta-glow background (amber radial bloom from top center over a vertical navy gradient) and overflow-hidden. Pin a 1px amber gradient top-line across the top (absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px, linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(240,180,41,0.55), transparent)) and an absolute faint grid overlay at ~70% opacity. Content lives in a relative mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-24->28 column, with the headline block centered in a max-w-3xl sub-column.

### Avatar + stars social-proof row
Above the CTA headline, mb-7, a centered flex row gap-3: LEFT = an overlapping (-space-x-2.5) cluster of four 32px round avatar chips, each a 12px font-bold initial (JL/MR/AK/SP) on a diagonal gradient fill (alternating amber gradients for navy-text chips and steel-blue navy gradients for cream-text chips) with a 2px navy-850 ring; RIGHT = a row of five amber ph:star-fill icons (~14px) beside a 13px cream/55 'loved by 1,200+ builders' label.

### CTA eyebrow + headline + subhead
Centered: an uppercase amber eyebrow (12px, font-bold, letter-spacing 0.22em, mb-5) 'Start building today'; then a text-balance h2 (text-3xl->[44px], font-extrabold, leading ~1.05, tight tracking) reading 'Ship your next interface' on line one and 'before the meeting ends.' on line two in AMBER; then a mx-auto max-w-lg mt-5 subhead (text-base->lg, leading-relaxed, cream/65): 'Join the teams already turning ideas into shippable UI in minutes, not sprints. Free to start, no credit card.'

### Dual button row
A mt-9 centered row that stacks full-width on mobile and goes row on sm (gap-3.5). PRIMARY = a glowing amber button 'Start designing free': rounded-xl, bg-amber, text-navy-900, font-bold, px-7 py-3.5, with the inset-highlight + blurred amber drop shadow (.btn-amber) and a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold that nudges right on group-hover. SECONDARY = a glass-outline button 'Watch a 90s demo': rounded-xl, border-white/15, bg-white/[0.03], text-cream, font-semibold, same padding, brightening its fill on hover, with a leading amber ph:play-circle-fill icon.

### Check-mark trust line
A mt-5 centered flex-wrap row (gap-x-5 gap-y-2, 13px font-medium cream/50) of three reassurance items, each an inline-flex with a 15px amber ph:check-circle-fill icon: 'No credit card', 'Free forever plan', 'Cancel anytime'.

### 4-up stat row
A mx-auto mt-16 max-w-4xl block: a grid that is 2-col on mobile and 4-col on sm (gap-x-6 gap-y-10, text-center). Each cell has a big number (text-4xl->[42px], font-extrabold, tight tracking, cream) over a 13px cream/55 two-line caption. Cells: '57k+' (the + in amber) / 'Designers & builders onboard'; '2.4M' / 'UI mockups generated'; '<30s' (the 30 in amber) / 'From prompt to first draft'; '4.9' + an inline amber ph:star-fill / 'Average rating across 1,200 reviews'. On sm, cells 2-4 carry a left vertical hairline divider via a ::before (h-12 w-px bg-white/10, centered).

### Soft divider + logo trust strip
A mx-auto mt-16 h-px max-w-3xl soft divider (linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(246,241,231,0.16), transparent)). Then mt-12: a centered 13px cream/45 label 'Trusted by design & engineering teams at fast-moving companies', and a mt-9 max-w-4xl logo row that is grayscale + ~55% opacity by default (grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6, gap-x-8 gap-y-9). Each logo is a flex item (a ph icon + a 19px font-bold tracked wordmark): triangle-fill 'Vertex', hexagon-fill 'Nimbus', circles-three-fill 'Outline', cube-fill 'Forge', diamond-fill 'Prism', waveform-bold 'Cadence'; on hover an individual logo goes full color + full opacity and lifts 1px.

### Footer
A border-t border-white/5 bg-navy-900 footer: a mx-auto max-w-6xl py-8 row that stacks on mobile / goes row on sm, items-center justify-between: LEFT = a small 28px rounded-md amber logo tile (ph:sparkle-fill) beside a 14px font-bold cream/85 'Promptcanvas'; CENTER = a 12px cream/40 copyright line '© 2026 Promptcanvas. Designed on the canvas, of course.'; RIGHT = three cream/50 social icons (ph:x-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:discord-logo-bold) that brighten on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Commit to ONE accent. Everything is navy + cream; amber #f0b429 appears only on: the headline payoff line (line two of each headline), the primary CTA button, the 5-star rating and the inline stat star, the uppercase eyebrow label, the check-circle trust icons, the small accent marks in stats (the '+' on 57k and the '30' in <30s), and small icon accents (the nav/footer logo glyph, the play-circle, the pill lightning). Build text hierarchy from cream opacity steps (text-cream down through cream/40), not from extra colors, so the amber stays the single point of emphasis.

### Componente
Two reusable glow backgrounds, both soft and bloom-from-top. .hero-glow = radial-gradient(80% 120% at 80% -20%, rgba(240,180,41,0.10), transparent 55%) over radial-gradient(70% 100% at 0% 0%, rgba(22,49,90,0.55), transparent 50%). .cta-glow = radial-gradient(120% 140% at 50% -6%, rgba(240,180,41,0.22), rgba(240,180,41,0.06) 28%, rgba(11,31,58,0) 58%) over a vertical navy gradient linear-gradient(180deg, #0d244a, #0b1f3a 38%, #081730). They give the dark field depth and pull the eye toward the CTA without any hard shapes.

### Componente
A barely-there technical grid that fades at the edges: background-image of two 1px cream lines at rgba(246,241,231,0.035), background-size 56px 56px, masked with mask-image: radial-gradient(100% 80% at 50% 30%, #000 30%, transparent 78%) (and the -webkit- prefix) so it is visible only in the center and dissolves outward. Placed as an absolute inset-0 layer behind hero and CTA content, at full strength in the hero and ~70% in the CTA.

### Componente
The primary CTA button reads as a warm light source: bg-amber, text-navy-900, rounded-xl, font-bold, with box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35) inset (a top sheen) plus 0 12px 30px -8px rgba(240,180,41,0.5) (a large soft amber glow). On hover the inset sheen and the glow both grow (inset rgba .45, shadow 0 16px 38px -8px rgba(240,180,41,0.62)) and the trailing ph:arrow-right-bold translates 0.5 right. Pair it with a quiet glass-outline secondary (border-white/15, bg-white/[0.03]) so only one button glows.

### Componente
A 1px hairline of light across the very top of the CTA section: an absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px element filled with linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(240,180,41,0.55) 50%, transparent). It seams the CTA band off from the hero with a thread of amber instead of a hard border.

### Componente
Social proof as a face cluster: four 32px round chips overlapping at -space-x-2.5, each holding 12px bold initials on a diagonal gradient (alternating amber gradients from-amber to-[#d99a12] / from-amber/80 to-[#c08a10] with navy text, and steel-blue gradients from-[#3a5a8c] to-[#16315a] / from-[#5a6e8c] to-[#2a3a55] with cream text) and a 2px navy-850 ring so they read as separated discs. Set beside five amber stars and a low-opacity 'loved by 1,200+ builders' line.

### Componente
Four metrics in a row, separated by thin vertical rules on desktop: a grid (2-col mobile, 4-col sm) of centered cells, each a big extrabold cream number over a 13px cream/55 two-line caption. The 2nd, 3rd and 4th cells draw a left vertical hairline via a sm:before pseudo-element (absolute left-0 top-1/2 h-12 w-px -translate-y-1/2 bg-white/10). Accent marks inside numbers (the '+', the '30', the inline star) are amber; the dividers disappear on the 2-col mobile reflow.

### Componente
A wordmark logo wall that is calm by default and rewards hover: the whole row is filter:grayscale(1) opacity .55, and each logo item transitions opacity/filter/transform so on hover it becomes full color + full opacity and lifts translateY(-1px). Logos are icon + bold tracked wordmark pairs (Phosphor ph icons: triangle / hexagon / circles-three / cube / diamond / waveform). It reflows 2 -> 3 -> 6 columns.

## Notas Especiais
Palette is navy + cream + ONE amber only: navy-900 #081730, navy-850 #0b1f3a, navy-800 #0f2747, navy-700 #16315a, cream #f6f1e7, amber #f0b429 (avatar gradient stops also use #d99a12 #c08a10 #3a5a8c #2a3a55 #5a6e8c, but no NEW hue is introduced as an accent). Hierarchy comes from cream opacity steps (full / 85 / 75 / 70 / 65 / 55 / 50 / 45 / 40), not extra colors. Single font: Inter via Google Fonts (400-900); headlines font-extrabold/900 tracking-tight leading-[1.05], eyebrows uppercase font-bold ~12px letter-spacing 0.22em, body reduced-opacity cream. Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:sparkle-fill, ph:lightning-fill, ph:star-fill, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:play-circle-fill, ph:check-circle-fill, ph:triangle-fill, ph:hexagon-fill, ph:circles-three-fill, ph:cube-fill, ph:diamond-fill, ph:waveform-bold, ph:x-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:discord-logo-bold). The whole language is soft glows + an edge-masked faint grid + opacity-driven cream hierarchy + the single glowing amber accent (payoff headline line, primary button, stars, eyebrow, checks) + hairline white-alpha dividers + a glass blurred nav. To transfer the STYLE, keep the navy/cream/one-amber discipline, the soft layered glows, and the opacity-based hierarchy. To transfer the LAYOUT, keep the framed page (glass nav -> compact context hero -> trust-led CTA: avatar+stars proof -> eyebrow/headline/subhead -> dual buttons -> check trust line -> 4-up hairline stat row -> soft divider -> grayscale logo strip -> footer). All copy avoids em-dashes.

Placed as an absolute inset-0 layer behind hero and CTA content, at full strength in the hero and ~70% in the CTA.

The primary CTA button reads as a warm light source: bg-amber, text-navy-900, rounded-xl, font-bold, with box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35) inset (a top sheen) plus 0 12px 30px -8px rgba(240,180,41,0.5) (a large soft amber glow). On hover the inset sheen and the glow both grow (inset rgba .45, shadow 0 16px 38px -8px rgba(240,180,41,0.62)) and the trailing ph:arrow-right-bold translates 0.5 right. Pair it with a quiet glass-outline secondary (border-white/15, bg-white/[0.03]) so only one button glows.

A 1px hairline of light across the very top of the CTA section: an absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px element filled with linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(240,180,41,0.55) 50%, transparent). It seams the CTA band off from the hero with a thread of amber instead of a hard border.

Social proof as a face cluster: four 32px round chips overlapping at -space-x-2.5, each holding 12px bold initials on a diagonal gradient (alternating amber gradients from-amber to-[#d99a12] / from-amber/80 to-[#c08a10] with navy text, and steel-blue gradients from-[#3a5a8c] to-[#16315a] / from-[#5a6e8c] to-[#2a3a55] with cream text) and a 2px navy-850 ring so they read as separated discs. Set beside five amber stars and a low-opacity 'loved by 1,200+ builders' line.

Four metrics in a row, separated by thin vertical rules on desktop: a grid (2-col mobile, 4-col sm) of centered cells, each a big extrabold cream number over a 13px cream/55 two-line caption. The 2nd, 3rd and 4th cells draw a left vertical hairline via a sm:before pseudo-element (absolute left-0 top-1/2 h-12 w-px -translate-y-1/2 bg-white/10). Accent marks inside numbers (the '+', the '30', the inline star) are amber; the dividers disappear on the 2-col mobile reflow.

A wordmark logo wall that is calm by default and rewards hover: the whole row is filter:grayscale(1) opacity .55, and each logo item transitions opacity/filter/transform so on hover it becomes full color + full opacity and lifts translateY(-1px). Logos are icon + bold tracked wordmark pairs (Phosphor ph icons: triangle / hexagon / circles-three / cube / diamond / waveform). It reflows 2 -> 3 -> 6 columns.

structured.special_notes: Palette is navy + cream + ONE amber only: navy-900 #081730, navy-850 #0b1f3a, navy-800 #0f2747, navy-700 #16315a, cream #f6f1e7, amber #f0b429 (avatar gradient stops also use #d99a12 #c08a10 #3a5a8c #2a3a55 #5a6e8c, but no NEW hue is introduced as an accent). Hierarchy comes from cream opacity steps (full / 85 / 75 / 70 / 65 / 55 / 50 / 45 / 40), not extra colors. Single font: Inter via Google Fonts (400-900); headlines font-extrabold/900 tracking-tight leading-[1.05], eyebrows uppercase font-bold ~12px letter-spacing 0.22em, body reduced-opacity cream. Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:sparkle-fill, ph:lightning-fill, ph:star-fill, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:play-circle-fill, ph:check-circle-fill, ph:triangle-fill, ph:hexagon-fill, ph:circles-three-fill, ph:cube-fill, ph:diamond-fill, ph:waveform-bold, ph:x-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:discord-logo-bold). The whole language is soft glows + an edge-masked faint grid + opacity-driven cream hierarchy + the single glowing amber accent (payoff headline line, primary button, stars, eyebrow, checks) + hairline white-alpha dividers + a glass blurred nav. To transfer the STYLE, keep the navy/cream/one-amber discipline, the soft layered glows, and the opacity-based hierarchy. To transfer the LAYOUT, keep the framed page (glass nav -> compact context hero -> trust-led CTA: avatar+stars proof -> eyebrow/headline/subhead -> dual buttons -> check trust line -> 4-up hairline stat row -> soft divider -> grayscale logo strip -> footer). All copy avoids em-dashes.
